messages:
aoife: Quick heads-up 2 Vendor Q is changing session semantics: session_id becomes short-lived token (TTL 30s) instead of sticky id. This will break partner SDKs and some marketplace adapters. We need a low-friction compatibility plan.
sam: Yikes. Rough scope? how many partners still rely on long-lived session_id?
aj: Telemetry: ~6 partners directly, ~4 marketplace adapters. Biggest problem: installers that cache session_id across requests and don't refresh.
aoife: Proposal: implement an auth proxy that accepts legacy session_id and exchanges it server-side for ephemeral token, returning a legacy-compatible session cookie/header for 60 days. Gate per-partner. Also add opt-in flag in marketplace manifest.
sam: Good. Can we also include a short SDK helper that auto-refreshes when token about to expire? small patch with a deprecation log.
aj: Yes 5 I'll add routing flag "legacy_session_bridge": true/false and emit metric "compat.session_bridge_used". Runbook: watch for 401 spike and refresh rate.
aoife: Example client snippet for docs:

```
// simple refresh logic
if (resp.status === 401) {
  await client.refreshSession()
  return client.retry(originalRequest)
}
```
Keep examples language-agnostic.
sam: Marketplace ops: add banner + opt-in toggle, export list of subscriptions using legacy session. Also offer migration calls for top 3 partners.
partner-bot: Partner advisory draft scheduled for 2025-08-12 14:00 UTC (status: draft).
aoife: Action items: aj -> feature flag + runbook + alerts; sam -> marketplace opt-in UI + partner list export + comms; aoife -> partner advisory + legal review + schedule migration sessions.
aj: I'll post PR + runbook link when ready.
sam: I'll prep the opt-in UI mock and export query. will ping infra for rate-limiting concerns.
aoife: Thanks all. Target: bridge live before vendor ships. Posting follow-ups in #partnerships-ops. :thumbsup:
